artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the spine and the small text boxes on the cover appear distorted and illegible, characteristic of AI-generated text rendering issues. Characters do not form coherent words.

The metal ring at the bottom looks physically implausible. It appears to melt into the cover or float without a clear anchor point to the spine mechanism. The geometry of the ring arm is irregular and lacks the precise engineering look of real binder hardware.
Slight blurring and 'smudging' where the colorful illustration meets the white border/spine area, suggesting imperfect segmentation or generation blending.
